name: The Wonder List
tagline: A guide to places of quality and style
description: The Wonder List is a guide to the best places to eat, drink and stay. Gold Card members get special access, perks at every visit and monthly gifts.
sampleNotice: Preview build. Venue details, descriptions and perks are sample content.

gold.title: Unlock luxury
gold.intro: Champagne on arrival, complimentary cocktails and the best tables in the house. The Wonder List Gold Card opens a world of wonder.

benefits.title: A perk at every visit
benefits.text: Show your Gold Card and be welcomed with something special, from a glass of champagne to a room upgrade.

benefits.title: Special access
benefits.text: Tables held for members, invitations to openings and events, and the use of private members' clubs.

benefits.title: Member discounts
benefits.text: Preferred rates at restaurants, bars, hotels and spas across the list.

benefits.title: Monthly gifts
benefits.text: Every month members have the chance to win gifts, from dinner for two to holidays.

occasionNotes.Smart: Polished rooms where a jacket never looks out of place.
occasionNotes.Casual: Easy, cheerful and no dress code.
occasionNotes.Business: Quiet enough to talk and good enough to close the deal.
occasionNotes.For friends: Big tables, sharing plates and a second bottle.
occasionNotes.Wild: Late, loud and worth the morning after.
occasionNotes.Romantic: Low light, good wine and tables for two.
occasionNotes.Impress: Rooms and plates that do the talking, for clients, parents and first dates.
occasionNotes.Lavish: For the nights when the answer to every question is yes.
occasionNotes.Calm: Unhurried rooms for a quiet night.
